verdicts.reason: A is just the original shrunk into the banner: the two-line headline sits about 15px from the top edge, the CTA almost touches the bottom, and the subline is tiny. All of this is crammed into a narrow central column with large dead areas on both sides, so it doesn't suit the wide format. B rearranges the headline onto one line that reads left to right, keeping the text larger and the hierarchy clear, but the headline runs nearly edge to edge with only ~15px side margins, and the gap between headline and subline is tight compared with the space around the button.
